description: This course provides an experimental knowledge of computerized controlled single cylinder 4-stroke Diesel Engine, computerized controlled 4-stroke high-speed Diesel Engine, multi cylinder petrol engine, effects of emission formation of IC engines. It also provides an introduction to air compressors and gas turbines, their types and applications.
experiments: To make a trial on computerized controlled single cylinder 4-stroke Diesel Engine to calculate B.H.P., S.F.C. and to draw its characteristics curves.
To make a trial on computerized controlled 4-stroke high-speed diesel engine and to draw its Heat Balance Sheet.
To make Morse Test to calculate IHP of the multi cylinder petrol engine and to determine its mechanical efficiency.
Study of different types of lubrication systems.
Study of fuel injection systems of a C.I. Engine.
To study battery ignition system for four cylinders S.I. engines and requirements of ignition system.
To study magneto ignition system for SI engine having four cylinders and differences between magneto and battery Ignition system.
Dissembling & assembling of the simple Carburetor.
To study Boiler and its components.
To study open cycle constant pressure combustion gas turbine with inter cooler, regenerator and reheater.
To study variable compression ignition engine.
To study of braking system of automobile in the lab.
Measurement of exhaust emission by using Exhaust gas analyzers.
outcomes: Identify the various types of I.C. Engines and Cycles of operation. Also express the effect of various operating variables on engine performance.
Illustrate the various engine systems like cooling, fuel injection, and lubrication system.
Understand the effects of emission formation of IC engines, its effects and the legislation standards.
Understand the performance of Gas Turbines.
